config.excludeFolders: Folder names to skip when searching subfolders.
config.maxFileSizeMB: Files larger than this size (MB) are skipped.
config.maxHitsPerFile: Maximum number of hits per file.
description: Search text inside Word, Excel and PowerPoint files in a folder, and see where it appears (sheet and cell, paragraph, slide).
config.excelShortDateFormat: Format of Excel dates entered without a specific format (the "Short Date" format), such as `yyyy/m/d` or `m/d/yyyy`. Leave empty to choose by the VS Code display language. Set this to match how dates appear in your Excel.
